label: second copy step (t = L+1, echoing first token) in long L=9 sequences, first token x/0/c
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase at recall_idx == 1 (step L+1, where the input is the echoed first original token and the model outputs original token 1). 100% of activations are at recall_idx 1; 92% of mass is at L = 9 and the rest at L = 8; it never fires on original or delimiter steps or at L <= 7. Within that slot, magnitude depends on the first token: x (42% of mass), 0 (29%), c (17%), with a weak tail of f/u/1. The top activations are all x/c/0 at L = 9. Precision is low (about 17%): most L=9 sequences that start with x/0/c still do not cross the threshold, so a further dependence on the rest of the sequence contents (sequences containing o or r are somewhat enriched) is not captured. Very sparse: about 0.03% of steps, small magnitudes.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=x (+5.07), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=0 (+4.65), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=c (+3.49), orig4=o (+2.59), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=f (+2.19), phase=2 & out_tok=f (+2.09).
